svg.title: Tier 5 against tier 4: late damage ratio
svg.desc: For the 30 tier 5s that deal damage, late DPS as a multiple of their tier 4 on a log scale, with the intended 3 to 5 times shaded.
svg.text: How many times its tier 4's damage each tier 5 deals (late DPS, every blind spot removed)

svg.text: Late DPS: damage per second over the last 3 waves it played, from wave 41 in endless, Veiled revealed and flyers hittable. The 3 Beacons and 3 Ember Vaults deal no damage, so have no ratio.
